first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark blue-black long gun in the lower-right foreground of the first-person view, with a box-shaped body, a wide flat top cover, and a silver-gray border.

entities.name: layered rock wall
entities.identification: The greenish-brown rock walls enclosing the passage, with horizontal wavy strata and prominent angular bends on their surfaces.

entities.name: gray-green passage floor
entities.identification: The gray-green, low-texture floor extending into the distance between the rock walls on both sides.

entities.name: blue sky opening
entities.identification: A small patch of bright blue sky within a gap at the top of the rock walls near the end of the clip.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person in the passage with short black hair, a light-colored face, and a dark blue-black uniform and trousers.

entities.name: white cloud of smoke
entities.identification: The grayish-white smoke-like mass beside Person A's shoulder and in front of the nearby wall, with soft edges and uneven density within.

entities.name: red stain
entities.identification: The irregular red stain on the lower part of the nearby rock wall's angular bend, later visible extending along the wall surface and the bend.

entities.name: light-colored sparks
entities.identification: A single small, short white bright spot above Person A's head and in front of the rock wall in frame 0.
